_comment: Category -> color registry (spec doc 06.5). Keys starting with '_' are reserved metadata; every other top-level key is a category dimension with {scope, values}. Universal defaults ship with the plugin; project-specific categories are added after METADATA.md exists. Every plotting script reads this file so a given category value uses the SAME color in every figure.

_palette.name: Okabe-Ito
_palette.note: Color-blind-friendly categorical palette. Color encodes at most 8 categories; beyond 8, change the encoding strategy (facet, second channel, group the tail, or position/sequential) rather than adding colors (doc 06.6).

cohort._note: Source cohort/site. Confounded with diagnostic group (see caveat finding).

group._note: Diagnostic group (Condition). ADD is the group of interest; given the standout vermillion.

primary_contrast._note: Binary primary contrast: ADD vs all others pooled.
